zh-CN.headlineView: 世界在开放与韧性之间重做基础设施
zh-CN.headlineFull: 饥饿缓降，AI算力上桌；世界在开放与韧性之间重做基础设施
zh-CN.intro: 从全球饥饿连续改善、微软与Mistral扩充欧洲AI算力和OpenAI小企业计划，到俄朝外交、美加关税、欧洲极端天气、道路安全与NISAR开放数据，今天的八条热点共同指向开放、韧性与基础设施重构。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 进展值得肯定，但真正的韧性来自把技术、制度与公共能力一起补齐。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 八条线索看似分散，其实都在回答怎样让系统更稳。

en-US.headlineFact: Hunger eases and AI capacity expands
en-US.headlineView: the world rebuilds infrastructure around openness and resilience
en-US.headlineFull: Hunger eases and AI capacity expands; the world rebuilds infrastructure around openness and resilience
en-US.intro: From easing hunger, European AI capacity and a small-business AI program to Russia-North Korea ties, Canada tariffs, extreme weather, road safety and open satellite data, today's eight stories point to a shared test of openness and resilience.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Stay informed and stay proactive; small actions today create a better tomorrow.
en-US.doudouQuote: See the bigger picture, act with kindness, and build a brighter world together.

sources.title: UN report: Global hunger levels ease for third consecutive year as regional disparities persist

zh-CN.headlineFact: 全球饥饿连续三年下降
zh-CN.headlineView: 进步仍被地区差距与健康饮食成本拉住
zh-CN.headlineFull: 全球饥饿连续三年下降；进步仍被地区差距与健康饮食成本拉住
zh-CN.intro: 联合国《2026年世界粮食安全和营养状况》显示，2025年全球饥饿率降至7.8%，约6.45亿人受影响，连续第三年改善；但地区差距与健康饮食高成本仍制约粮食安全。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 改善值得庆祝，更重要的是把公平获得食物变成长期能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 吃得饱还要吃得好，进步要覆盖每个地区。

en-US.headlineFact: Global hunger eases for a third year
en-US.headlineView: regional gaps and healthy diet costs persist
en-US.headlineFull: Global hunger eases for a third year; regional gaps and healthy diet costs persist
en-US.intro: The 2026 UN food security report estimates that hunger affected 7.8% of the world's population in 2025, or about 645 million people. Progress continued for a third year, but regional gaps and the cost of healthy diets remain severe.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Good news, keep going. Fair food today, stronger future tomorrow.
en-US.doudouQuote: Eat well, grow well, dream big—together.

sources.title: UN report: Global hunger levels ease for third consecutive year as regional disparities persist

zh-CN.headlineFact: 微软数十亿美元采购Mistral欧洲算力
zh-CN.headlineView: 主权AI从口号走向基础设施
zh-CN.headlineFull: 微软数十亿美元采购Mistral欧洲算力；主权AI从口号走向基础设施
zh-CN.intro: 微软与法国Mistral宣布数十亿美元合作，微软将使用Mistral在欧洲扩充的GPU基础设施，并把Medium 3.5与OCR 4加入Foundry，为欧洲客户和受监管行业提供更多本地部署选择。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI主权最终不是一句口号，而是谁拥有计算、能源与部署选择。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 模型会越来越多，能在本地稳定运行才是真底座。

en-US.headlineFact: Microsoft and Mistral form a multibillion-dollar European AI capacity partnership
en-US.headlineView: sovereign AI ambitions shift from slogans to infrastructure
en-US.headlineFull: Microsoft and Mistral form a multibillion-dollar European AI capacity partnership; sovereign AI ambitions shift from slogans to infrastructure
en-US.intro: Microsoft agreed to use Mistral's expanding GPU infrastructure in Europe and distribute more of the French company's models through Microsoft Foundry, giving customers and regulated industries additional Europe-based deployment options.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Build the base, empower innovation, keep the future in our hands.
en-US.doudouQuote: Stronger compute, smarter future—sovereign AI starts with solid infrastructure.

sources.title: Microsoft to fund Mistral's European AI expansion in multibillion-dollar deal

zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司开始获得可落地的AI运营体系
zh-CN.headlineFull: OpenAI推出小企业计划；一人公司开始获得可落地的AI运营体系
zh-CN.intro: OpenAI推出ChatGPT小企业计划，提供线上培训、线下AI学院、上手指南以及面向小企业工作流的代理、技能和合作伙伴资源，帮助精简团队把AI用于营销、会计、电商与运营。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司真正需要的不是更多按钮，而是能反复执行的运营系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 会用AI只是起点，让它每天稳定干活才算升级。

en-US.headlineView: giving lean companies a more practical AI operating system
en-US.headlineFull: OpenAI launches a small-business program; giving lean companies a more practical AI operating system
en-US.intro: OpenAI's new program combines virtual training, in-person AI academies, practical guides, agents, skills and partner resources to help small businesses use ChatGPT in accounting, marketing, ecommerce and operations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI levels the playing field—solopreneurs can now run lean and compete big.
en-US.doudouQuote: Big dreams don't need big teams—smart tools make it possible.

sources.title: Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program

zh-CN.headlineView: 俄朝高层协作继续向长期联盟靠拢
zh-CN.headlineFull: 普京会见朝鲜外相；俄朝高层协作继续向长期联盟靠拢
zh-CN.intro: 普京在莫斯科会见朝鲜外相崔善姬，并感谢朝方支持俄方对乌军事行动；朝俄外长另行会谈，双方再次强调安全与外交支持，高层互动正从事件性合作转向长期协调。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 观察联盟不能只看会晤次数，更要看安全承诺是否变成长期结构。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 高层互动越密集，地区安全的连锁影响越要看清。

en-US.headlineFact: Putin meets North Korea's foreign minister
en-US.headlineView: high-level cooperation moves closer to a long-term alliance
en-US.headlineFull: Putin meets North Korea's foreign minister; high-level cooperation moves closer to a long-term alliance
en-US.intro: Putin met North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui in Moscow and thanked Pyongyang for backing Russia's war in Ukraine. Separate foreign-minister talks reiterated mutual security and diplomatic support.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Watch the structure, not the noise. Alliances today reshape power tomorrow.
en-US.doudouQuote: Small partnerships can create big ripples. Peace needs patience and clear boundaries.

sources.title: Russian President Putin meets with North Korean foreign minister in latest high-level diplomacy

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国对部分加拿大商品加征50%关税
zh-CN.headlineView: 北美贸易规则再被单边工具改写
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国对部分加拿大商品加征50%关税；北美贸易规则再被单边工具改写
zh-CN.intro: 白宫依据《1930年关税法》第338条，对部分加拿大汽车、酒类和乳制品加征50%关税，计划8月19日生效；能源、钾肥及部分其他商品被排除，关税也适用于部分符合USMCA原产地规则的商品。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 关税可以迅速抬高边境成本，但供应链调整往往更慢也更贵。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 政策一改，企业的库存、路线和价格都要跟着重排。

en-US.headlineFact: The United States imposes additional tariffs on Canada
en-US.headlineView: testing how long cross-border supply chains can absorb repeated policy shocks
en-US.headlineFull: The United States imposes additional tariffs on Canada; testing how long cross-border supply chains can absorb repeated policy shocks
en-US.intro: The White House imposed additional 50% tariffs on selected Canadian vehicles, alcoholic beverages and dairy products under Section 338, with an August 19 effective date and exclusions for energy, potash and some other goods.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Trade frictions are a tax on efficiency. Diversify and build resilience.
en-US.doudouQuote: Big barriers bring big costs. Flexible chains stay strong.

sources.title: Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Imposes Additional Tariffs on Canada

zh-CN.headlineView: 极端天气同时考验多条防灾系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧洲野火与冰雹并发；极端天气同时考验多条防灾系统
zh-CN.intro: 西班牙与法国多地继续扑救野火，部分地区气温超过40摄氏度；巴尔干地区同时遭遇冰雹和强对流。高温、干旱、火灾与强降水并发，城市与区域应急系统面临复合风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 韧性不能只为一种灾害设计，复合风险需要跨部门联动。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一边防火、一边防冰雹，应急系统要同时跑多条线。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与环境。

en-US.headlineFact: Wildfires and hail strike Europe at the same time
en-US.headlineView: extreme weather is testing multiple disaster-response systems
en-US.headlineFull: Wildfires and hail strike Europe at the same time; extreme weather is testing multiple disaster-response systems
en-US.intro: Crews battled wildfires in Spain and France as temperatures exceeded 40°C in places, while hail and severe storms hit parts of the Balkans. Concurrent heat, drought, fire and storms are testing regional response systems.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Resilience is built in advance, not in the middle of the disaster.
en-US.doudouQuote: Plan for the worst, prepare together, recover better—strong communities win.

sources.title: Fires in Spain and France, hail in Balkans; Europe's erratic weather persists

zh-CN.headlineFull: 全球道路死亡率下降21%；但仍需更强行动
zh-CN.intro: WHO新数据称，2011至2025年全球道路交通死亡率下降21%，即使全球机动车增加逾10亿辆；但2025年道路交通事故仍造成116万人死亡，并是5至29岁人群的主要死因。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 每一次安全改善都来自持续治理，不能把下降当作终点。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 慢一点、稳一点，让每个人都平安回家。

en-US.headlineFact: WHO reports global road deaths fell 21%
en-US.headlineView: but stronger action is still needed
en-US.headlineFull: WHO reports global road deaths fell 21%; but stronger action is still needed
en-US.intro: WHO says the global road traffic death rate fell 21% between 2011 and 2025 despite more than one billion additional vehicles. Even so, crashes killed 1.16 million people in 2025 and remain the leading killer of people aged 5–29.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Every life counts. Safer roads make cities kinder and the future brighter.
en-US.doudouQuote: Slow down, buckle up, and keep everyone safe on the road.

sources.title: Road deaths fall by 21% globally but stronger action is needed to save lives

zh-CN.headlineView: 助力全球环境监测与研究
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA与ISRO开放NISAR卫星数据；助力全球环境监测与研究
zh-CN.intro: NASA与ISRO联合任务NISAR开始提供新一批开放雷达数据。其L波段与S波段观测可穿透云雨和部分植被，用于监测地表形变、冰川、生态系统、农作物与自然灾害。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 开放的数据，让每个人都能看见地球正在发生的变化。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 看得更清楚，才能做得更好，保护地球我们一起加油。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：科技与太空。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA and ISRO open NISAR satellite data
en-US.headlineView: enabling global environmental monitoring and research
en-US.headlineFull: NASA and ISRO open NISAR satellite data; enabling global environmental monitoring and research
en-US.intro: New NISAR radar data are becoming openly available through NASA and ISRO channels. The joint mission's L- and S-band observations support research on surface change, ice, ecosystems, agriculture and natural hazards.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Open data is open doors. Shared knowledge builds a better world.
en-US.doudouQuote: Watch the Earth together. Small data, big impact.
